name: Dallas Independent School District
districtFact: Dallas ISD publishes separate traditional and ADSY calendars. This page focuses on the traditional districtwide student calendar; campus events, testing dates, bell schedules, and school-choice deadlines may be published separately.

about.title: Calendar Scope
about.content: Dallas ISD serves students across Dallas and nearby communities, but district boundaries do not always match city limits. Use the official Dallas ISD calendar for districtwide student dates and campus calendars for bell schedules, testing windows, school events, and program-specific deadlines.

districtFaqs.q: Does every Dallas ISD school follow the traditional calendar?
districtFaqs.a: No. Dallas ISD also publishes ADSY and program-specific calendars. This page summarizes the traditional districtwide student calendar unless a separate calendar is explicitly linked.

districtFaqs.q: Where should families verify Dallas ISD calendar updates?
districtFaqs.a: Use the official Dallas ISD district calendars page for final confirmation before making travel, child care, or campus-specific plans.
